name: qkh_head_hs_ref-q13b-COMMIT
purpose: TP8 KV read head (die cell qkd_rhead x128), two-level cluster 16 closed lane8 + closed ktree. q13b: shared S2b relay stage, symmetric clock spine, corrected child ETMs, recipe 2 (successor of q13a TT -41.92 / FF -64.05). Gates: TT/FF >= 0, DRC 0, layer_hs_pos 14/14 exact + HEAD_HS_TPUT <= 1.10 x 1816, HSMUT mutant FAIL, nr_standin EQUIV.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qwen_nearhbm_head_hs u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_head_hs.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_subtiles_bb.v rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: layer_hs_pos
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && HSUB=1 DQ=64 HT=1 SBD=16 HUBT=1 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/bench_gate.sh pos {RUN}/bench/hs_pos && python3 tools/qwen_kv_die/head_hs_tput_gate.py {RUN}/bench/hs_pos/results.jsonl {RUN}/bench/head_hs_tput.json

bench.name: layer_hs_mut
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && HSUB=1 HSMUT=1 DQ=64 HT=1 SBD=16 HUBT=1 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/bench_gate.sh neg {RUN}/bench/hs_neg 0

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkh_head_hs_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkh_head_hs_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkh_head_hs_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qwen_nearhbm_head_hs --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkh_ktree_ref/views/ot_qkh_ktree --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkh_lane8_ref_b/views/ot_qkh_lane8 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: q13-rhead r2 after q13a TT -41.92 / FF -64.05: (1) new SHARED mid-floor relay stage S2b (NRS=1, 1,577 flops) between the S-face pin flops and the 16 per-lane relays, so no hop crosses > ~430 um (q13a worst: qd2 pin flop -> row-3 lane relay, 765 ps data in one cycle); +1 cycle on every input (HXK/HXN). (2) parent clock = symmetric insertion-aware spine (OT_SPINE_SYM + TREE_PAD): the 17 hard children tap near the root by their measured insertion instead of at full depth (q13a: 1.19 ns insertion, 15,794 spine cells, routed boundary spread 138 ps TT / 94 ps FF = the input-hold miss). (3) children ETMs replaced by the verdict-replay re-export (export-SDC fix). (4) kit recipe 2: pin hold stages + pin flops, hold margin 30 ps, halo 5.4 um.
